text:
[LSIG.6.1] The v1 aggregations are exact over the *observed* event stream,
but their fidelity to the *physical* process depends on assumptions the
substrate does not guarantee. The recurring rule: these primitives are
trustworthy paired with a liveness check, not alone. Over a lossy transport,
an author should pair them with an independent rate or heartbeat signal.

| Aggregation | Exact w.r.t. | Key assumption | Failure mode if it breaks | Pair with |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `active_fraction` | observed transition stream | every transition observed; adapter asserts initial `true` on connect | a lost falling edge biases it high without self-correcting; an already-on sensor under-reports for ≤ W after connect | `onset_rate` and/or a `scope ttl` heartbeat |
| `onset_rate` | observed rising edges | edges are genuine onsets, not chatter | un-debounced chatter inflates it | debounce upstream |
| `integral` | piecewise-constant fact model | every value change observed; correct `gap` policy | `gap hold` over a dead sensor accrues without bound; rectangle error ≤ granularity × W vs the true signal | `gap zero` for rates; liveness for held quantities |
